justification: Both surfaces bear low-relief carving including at least one animal-like figure amid curving incised lines, but A shows dense, orderly rows of small standardised script-like signs beneath a naturalistic quadruped, whereas B shows a few large, bold, schematic spirals and crescent forms with no repeated sign register. The correspondence is limited to the generic fact of carved curvilinear/figural motifs, which any tradition could produce independently.
